gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-asimovian: A splayed c terminal and tube-like strokes give Tilt Neon its glow-sign swagger. Asimovian follows in a plain sans, tall in every lowercase letter, where the heading shouts and the body just talks.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-basic: Tilt Neon draws every stroke as a uniform tube, with a splayed c terminal as its signature. Basic comes in underneath as sans-serif with only a faint contrast, its capitals rising gently above the small letters.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-cal-sans: Commanding is how Tilt Neon lands, its tube-like strokes and large x-height making each heading feel switched on. Cal Sans carries the text with short ascenders and a tall x-height.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-carlito: A splayed c terminal gives Tilt Neon its signature, with crossbars every bit as heavy as the stems. Carlito is the sans-serif for reading, with round, open letters and tight spacing.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-changa: Changa brings a lowercase with the stature of cast iron capitals, giving the plain sans real heft. And Tilt Neon, bent like a paperclip, sits above it, so a larger heading keeps their weights distinct.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-courier-prime: Precise is the mood Courier Prime sets, with its drafting-pen line. Tilt Neon's bold tube strokes and large x-height lead above it, while the monospace text fills most of its height and keeps generous round mouths.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-days-one: A glowing thread of ink, no swelling or tapering anywhere, with a splayed c terminal. Days One adds sans-serif letters spaced like rungs on a rope ladder, and its x-height fills the line so the pair feels dense and confident.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-epunda-sans: Epunda Sans reads with oversized e and a counters and curves full of daylight. And if Tilt Neon were shrunk down, its one-thickness tube strokes would lose their punch, while this sans would be fine blown up.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-farro: Farro keeps its ascenders compressed and its strokes without any contrast, a sans-serif with an approachable face. Tilt Neon shines at bold, splayed-terminal display moments, while Farro does the quieter work.
gen-gf-tilt-neon-gf-fragment-mono: Fragment Mono lays letters out like nails on a ruler. Its tall waist line and absence of thick-and-thin contrast pair with Tilt Neon's tube strokes, so both feel machined, one loud and one exact.
